title: Support VAT return reporting frequencies in Denmark
summary: The Danish electronic VAT declaration system now supports multiple reporting frequencies - monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual periods - parsed from SKAT VAT return data, with a legacy quarterly fallback feature flag and enhanced validation.
key_points: Added ElecVATDeclRepFrequency enum to represent reporting frequency types
Extended VAT period calculation logic to handle monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual frequencies
Implemented validation to prevent overlapping VAT return periods and reject invalid due dates
Retained legacy quarterly fallback behind feature flag DKElecVAT-ReportingFrequencyEnabled
Expanded test coverage with focused scenarios for various frequency calculations
quote: support monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual period calculations
